purpose: Teach: 分かれる/目立ち/気がつか/ゆかり/枯れ/残ら/落とさ/贈る

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、駅で、お友達と道、分かれる時、寂しい。
lines.en: Mom, when I say goodbye to my friend at the station, it makes me sad.
lines.style: Soft, hesitant voice. Small pause between thoughts like he's gathering courage to say something true. Gentle trailing-off on the last word, like he's checking if it's okay to feel this way.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、髪型、目立ちすぎないように整えてた。
lines.en: Dad was careful to keep his hair neat and not stand out.
lines.style: Observant, almost thinking aloud. Tender recognition in the voice — noticing something he did without mentioning it. Warm, steady rhythm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん。ママの誕生日、気がつかなかったらどうしよう、不安。
lines.en: Yeah. What if I forget your birthday and don't realize it until too late?
lines.style: Quiet worry underneath. The words come faster now — anxiety overtaking his usual reserve. Soft emphasis on the 'what if.' Ends uncertain, seeking reassurance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ご先祖ゆかりの神社、お正月、お参りに行こうね。
lines.en: Let's go visit the shrine that belonged to our ancestors when it's New Year's.
lines.style: Gentle forward-planning voice. Warm invitation rather than instruction. Slight pause before 'the shrine' like she's picturing it. Steady, grounding tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お花、枯れちゃった、悲しい。
lines.en: The flowers died. That makes me sad.
lines.style: Very soft, withdrawn. The grief is real but expressed simply, without drama. Long micro-pause before 'sad' like the feeling settles on him. Almost a whisper at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 食事、残らないように、ちゃんと食べてね。
lines.en: When you eat, try not to leave any food on your plate, all right?
lines.style: Practical care wrapped in gentleness. Not commanding but steady — the voice of someone who knows what matters and says it without fussing. Light touch of mother-wisdom.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お小遣い、財布から、落とさないでね。
lines.en: Be careful not to lose your allowance from your wallet, okay?
lines.style: Earnest small-child concern. Gentle but specific — he's thought about this. The voice is careful, protective without being controlling. Ends with a small lift, checking she'll remember.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: クリスマス、お父さんに、心を込めて何かを贈るのもいいね。
lines.en: It would be nice to give Dad a gift for Christmas with your whole heart in it.
lines.style: Warm suggestion blooming into a soft smile. The words come gently, opening an idea rather than directing it. Tender recognition of what he might want to do. Slight warmth rising at the end.
